releases.title: Background monitoring, with alerts when you need them.
releases.summary: A compact menu-bar popup, optional usage alerts and appearance that follows your settings.

sections.title: Installing this update
items: If you use Llumi 1.1.3 or earlier, install 2.2.0 manually once: quit Llumi, open the downloaded disk image, replace Llumi in Applications and reopen it. Your settings and provider-owned sign-ins are retained.
This one-time installation moves Llumi to its new signed update feed. The previous updater signing key could not be recovered, so older versions cannot install 2.2.0 through Check for Updates.
After installing 2.2.0, future compatible releases are checked and downloaded automatically when Automatic Updates is on. That preference stays yours: with it off, use Check for Updates.
When an update is ready, choose Restart and update or Later. Later keeps Llumi running; the prepared update can install when you quit.

sections.title: Llumi in the background
items: Start in background opens Llumi without its main window and keeps the Dock clear. Launch at login remains a separate setting.
Open the menu-bar popup for supported providers, real usage windows, available reset times and last-refresh or stale status. Refresh, Settings, Open Llumi and Quit remain within reach.
Closing the main window keeps monitoring active. Open Llumi brings back the full interface; Quit stops the app. Launching it again reuses the running instance.
The popup follows your System, Light or Dark appearance choice in Llumi. The notch monitor remains an independent option.

sections.title: Optional usage alerts
items: Usage alerts are off by default. After opting in, the default thresholds are 75%, 90% and 95% used. Enable, disable or edit each threshold and choose providers individually.

Each quota window is tracked and named separately. Alerts are sent once per threshold per account and window, with that history kept across restarts. Crossing several thresholds at once sends only the highest newly crossed alert.
Enabling alerts above a threshold sends at most one current-status notification. Alerts re-arm only for a fresh provider-reported window; stale, invalid or uncertain readings never trigger them.
Settings explains notification permission and includes a test notification. macOS notification controls still apply. Alerts warn you; they do not pause agents or enforce spending limits.

sections.title: Reliable usage
items: Fixes supported Claude quotas with missing or null usage being treated as valid readings. Missing values remain unknown, and previous verified readings are clearly marked stale when retained.
Claude Code and Codex remain the supported providers. No new provider integrations are included in 2.2.0.

releases.notice: Requires macOS 14 or later. Upgrading from 1.1.3 or earlier requires one manual installation. Future compatible updates use the new signed feed and follow your Automatic Updates setting.

releases.title: Usage alerts and quieter launches.
releases.summary: Optional usage alerts, snooze controls and Start in background for Windows.

sections.title: Usage alerts
items: Get optional Windows notifications for Codex and Claude Code. Alerts start off, with editable thresholds at 75%, 90% and 95% used.
Choose distinct whole percentages from 1 to 100. Enable each provider and threshold separately.
Alerts use fresh, verified usage readings and reported reset times. Handled thresholds stay remembered across restarts, so the same warning does not keep repeating.
Send a test notification from Settings and check notification availability. Windows notification settings and Do Not Disturb still apply.

sections.title: Alert snooze
items: Snooze alerts for one hour or until tomorrow at 09:00 local time, or resume early. The saved deadline stays visible in Settings.
Monitoring continues during snooze. Alerts resume without a backlog, including after sleep, offline time or restart.
Test notifications remain available during snooze without consuming usage thresholds.

sections.title: Start in background
items: Choose whether ordinary launches open the main window. Start in background is off by default and is separate from Launch at Startup; login launches remain quiet.
First-time setup stays visible. Open Llumi again to restore its existing window. Changing the setting applies to future launches.
With the tray icon disabled, background launches keep a minimized taskbar window. Closing keeps monitoring active; Quit exits Llumi.

sections.title: Settings improvements
items: Settings keeps its scroll position while provider status updates.
Invalid threshold edits show an unsaved warning while other alert switches and snooze controls remain usable.

releases.notice: Available through Microsoft Store for Windows 10 22H2 or later and Windows 11 on x64. Updates are managed by Microsoft Store. Alerts warn about usage; they do not stop agents or limit spending.

releases.title: A clearer Windows experience.
releases.summary: Simpler setup, complete allowance details and a steadier compact monitor.

sections.title: Getting started
items: A clean Light setup with sharp Llumi artwork, illustrated PowerShell walkthroughs and animated provider switches.
Setup always uses Light. Existing preferences move to Light once; your later appearance choices stay saved.
Turn Codex and Claude Code monitoring on or off during setup and in Settings. Disabled providers stop monitoring and leave the Usage view and monitor; both can be off.
Check Setup separates sign-in readiness from monitoring availability, with Retry when another check can run.

sections.title: Usage and allowances
items: See every supported general, model and additional time allowance, with clear labels, remaining percentages and reset times when reported.
The compact monitor prioritizes a general five-hour limit, then a general weekly limit, then the shortest other supported general window. Model limits stay in the details.
Clearer Not reported, Unsupported format, Unsupported billing, Unavailable and Stale states preserve the difference between unknown, zero and exhausted allowances.
Fixes intermittent Claude readings disappearing after a failed usage request. Previous readings remain visibly Stale only after the same account is verified; account changes and sign-out clear them.
Retries and reset refreshes respect provider limits, with bounded waits after repeated failures and no overlapping requests.
Softer cards, rounded controls and quieter date labels keep Usage focused on your allowances.

sections.title: Your monitor
items: Drag without triggering hover expansion, with a movement threshold that follows display scaling.
Keep a stable position when expanding details or changing displays. Reset Position returns it to its default location.
Expanded details include provider names and observation dates. Open Usage shows additional limits when space is limited.
Clearer keyboard focus, accessible allowance details and brief animations that respect Windows motion preferences.

sections.title: About Llumi
items: Find the installed version in About and open release notes on the Llumi website. Simpler menus remove repeated actions.
Windows updates continue to be managed by Microsoft Store.

releases.notice: Submitted to Microsoft Store on 8 October 2026 and currently in certification. Version 2.1.3 will be available after Microsoft completes review and publication; the last verified public version is 2.0.2.0.

releases.title: A clearer view of your usage.
releases.summary: Simpler setup, more complete allowance details and a monitor you can move.

sections.title: Getting started
items: A lighter welcome screen with the Llumi app icon.
Turn Codex and Claude Code monitoring on or off during setup and in Settings.
Simpler setup steps with slower installation illustrations.
Check Setup separates sign-in readiness from monitoring availability. Retry explains when another check can run while respecting provider rate limits.

sections.title: Usage and allowances
items: View the supported limits your account reports, with clear labels, remaining percentages and reset times when available.
The compact monitor prioritizes the five-hour limit, then the weekly limit. If neither is reported, it uses another supported time window.
Clearer missing, unsupported, unavailable and stale states. Saved readings are cleared if your account changes or cannot be verified.
Codex and Claude usage cards have equal sizing, clearer light-mode boundaries and consistent provider artwork.

sections.title: Your monitor
items: Drag the monitor to a position that suits you. Llumi saves its position and keeps it within the display.
Expanded details show the supported limits for each provider. Command-1 opens the complete Usage view.

sections.title: Updates
items: One Settings switch enables automatic checking and downloading. With it off, updates remain manual.
Check for Updates checks and downloads an available application update without changing your automatic-update choice.
When a downloaded update is ready, choose Restart and update or Later. Later keeps Llumi running; the prepared update can install when you quit.
After a verified update, Llumi shows a one-time confirmation with a link to that version’s release notes.
Your first update from 1.1.2 uses its existing updater. The new completion popup stays quiet unless installation can be verified.

releases.notice: Requires macOS 14 or later. Existing 1.1.2 users can update through Llumi.

releases.title: In-app updates arrive.
releases.summary: Update support for future macOS releases and clearer Claude usage labels.

sections.title: What's new
items: Adds in-app update support for future macOS releases.
Prevents internal Claude usage bucket names from appearing in the Usage interface.

releases.notice: Existing Llumi 1.1.1 users need to install 1.1.2 manually once. Future compatible macOS updates can then be installed directly from Llumi.
